model_output.verdict: A distribution supervisor whose team and daily work are clear, with a few details left to fill in.
write_up: Your resume tells a clear story from order picker at Basin Retail Supply to outbound shift supervisor at Sierra Freight Distribution. A recruiter can see the team you run and the work that keeps the night shift moving. The main question is how much order volume you plan around and what your work changed.

Your strongest line is the one about supervising 35 associates across picking, packing, and loading. It gives a recruiter both the team and its work in one quick pass. The move from lead associate to supervisor also makes your progression easy to follow.

Let's start with the labor scheduling line and add the order volume if you can confirm it. Then fill in what you handled while covering for the supervisor and what part you played in the scanner rollout. Keep the team line as your model.

fit.why: Your headline and current role both point to supervising distribution center operations.

fit.note: Your progression at Sierra Freight Distribution points toward warehouse and outbound operations supervision. The OSHA credential, Manhattan WMS and bilingual skills add useful context for that work.
